description.en: I design the REST and GraphQL interfaces behind M4, review code, and keep the platform workable across VMs and cloud. Those interfaces now serve three product lines.
description.zh: 负责 M4 背后的 REST 与 GraphQL 接口设计、代码评审，并让平台在虚拟机和云上都能稳定运行；这些接口目前服务三条产品线。

description.en: Modernized a weather system: moved a Flask API to FastAPI services, tripled throughput, halved latency, and made deploys simpler.
description.zh: 改造气象系统：将 Flask API 迁移到 FastAPI 服务，吞吐量提升至约 3 倍、延迟降低约一半，同时让部署更简单。

description.en: Integrated ML components into Python workflows and built a Vue and Flask service for a client-facing product.
description.zh: 把机器学习组件接入 Python 业务流程，并用 Vue 与 Flask 交付一套面向客户的服务。
